set.body:
Implement a small public dataset descriptor for one licensed comparator dataset: immutable URL/archive hash, license, member hashes, geometry, clocks and subject/trial identities. Reuse existing IO admission and benchmark fixture tooling. Provide an explicit fetch command and offline cache verification; never silently download in a pure API. Acceptance: one dataset admitted through public APIs, corrupt archive/member and missing metadata rejected, runnable example and provenance receipt. This is the first dataset-access slice, not a catalog. Queue catalog and additional format slices before closing PM1.

Keep each implementation review below roughly half a day; if the scope exceeds that, split before implementation and retain the parent acceptance. Follow repository law/mutation and landing gates. This is required gap work owned by the comparison epic; completion needs evidence, not title closure.
set.title: PM1.2 Admit one shared public dataset through a reusable dataset descriptor
